lines: A few days after the raid on Gosha by a mysterious squadー
Me
So, we managed to defend Yukikaze's castle, but the identity of that armed group is still unknown.
Me
All of the enemy soldiers were publicly presumed dead long ago.
Asagi
Sounds like one of those zombie squads.
Me
It does. Shikanosuke was on the verge of tears when he found out later.
Asagi
Same Shikanosuke as ever. It's the same with that group that attacked Director Yamamoto and me as well. We still don't know who they were.
Me
I knew it...
Asagi
They were foolish enough to underestimate us.
Asagi
But apparently, they know better than to leave behind clues to identify them.
Me
Or rather, perhaps it shows how cautious the people who used them were.
Asagi
Mine Funako and the Cabinet. You think they are behind this, right?
Me
I do.
I nodded in agreement without hesitation.
Officially, the raid had been announced to be carried out by a mysterious armed group, but all of the circumstantial evidence pointed to Mine Funako.
And Asagi-sensei and I seemed to be on the same page.
Me
But what bothers me is Major's escape.
Asagi
It's been giving me a headache too.
Asagi-sensei made an uncharacteristically frustrated face.
During the battle at Yukikaze's castle, an internment camp was attacked while it was lax in security.
Two Taimanin guards were killed.
And Major, a UFS cyborg who'd been held captive there, escaped.
Who aided her jailbreak was still under investigationー
Me
I heard the two guards were killed instantly before they could even draw their katana.
Asagi
Yes, and unless the perpetrator was a master of stealth on Sakura's level...
Asagi faltered.
As the headmistress of Gosha Academy, she must not have wanted to finish that thought.
Sensing Asagi-sensei's feelings, I finished the rest of it for her.
Me
There had to be aid from someone within Gosha. In other words, there's a traitor in the village who's connected with the Cabinet. We have no choice but to believe that.
Asagi
*Sigh...* I don't even want to consider that.
Asagi-sensei sighed and began to review the situation as if to sort out her feelings.
Asagi
So the Cabinet took Major to make up for their failure to acquire Sago Bungo, or maybe their failure to retrieve Clear.
Me
It's also possible that the two attacks were just a diversion, and Major's escape was the Cabinet's real objective.
Asagi
It could be.
Me
Aren't we going to pay back the Cabinet for this?
Asagi
Oh? That's unusually hawkish of you.
Me
Umm, it's not like that.
After teasing me, Asagi-sensei began to speak in a serious tone.
Asagi
That's the director's job. Those matters are highly political. We just do what we can.
Me
It was exactly as she said, but whether I could accept it was a different matter.
That must have shown on my face because Asagi-sensei then spoke in a gentle voice.
Asagi
Don't make that face. You did great work this time, Fuma-kun.
It didn't feel like "great work" to me.
It felt more like defeat because I had played right into Mine Funako's hand despite laying a trap of my own.
Me
Um, there's something I want to ask...
Setting aside that sense of bitter defeat, there was one more thing I had to confirm.
The truth of Sago's assassination.
Asagi
I know.
Before I could even finish speaking, Asagi-sensei called out to the back of the principal's office.
A door opened and a man came in.
At a glance, it was a menacing-looking cyborg.
Asagi
Let me introduce you. This is "Taimanin Library." Gosha's first cyborg Taimanin.
Me
A cyborg Taimanin... You mean...!?
Library
It's been a while, young lord.
Taimanin Library.
It was just a disguise to keep out of the public eye.
He was Sago Bungo, who was supposed to be dead.
Asagi had gotten assistance from Kurenai and the others and faked Sago's death in order to deceive the UFS and the Cabinet.
The faked assassination had turned out to be a complete success, and Sago had been hidden at Gosha.
And Sago, who'd been nearing the end of his life as a UFS cyborg,
had wished to once again undergo cyborg modification surgery at Gosha.
He'd been reborn as a cyborg Taimanin by the latest cyborg technologies.
A new body called for a new name.
And that name was "Taimanin Library."
ーThat was what occurred a few weeks ago.
Sago Bungo had started living as Gosha's first cyborg Taimanin, "Taimanin Library."
That was what he wished for.
He'd once served under Fuma Danjo and engaged in his rebellion. And even after Danjo's death, he'd continued to fight against Gosha Taimainin by turning himself into a UFS cyborg.
At the end of that long battle, Sago had left the UFS to visit the grave of his daughter, who'd died when she was caught up in Gaiza's rebellion.
Even though he'd known full well that his mechanized body couldn't last long without the UFS's maintenance.
Not as an avenger, but as a fatherーit was supposed to be his last wish to see his daughter.
There was no way a greenhorn like me could possibly understand what kind of change of heart he had undergone.
However, after having exchanged a brief, silent conversation with his daughter at her grave, Sago suddenly told me that he would swear his loyalty to me.
I'd naturally been a bit surprised, but Sago, no, Library, did not seem to have any doubt about his decision.
To me, it was the best news I could've hoped for.
And so, he was presently working in the Oniwaban as a guard of the Fuma head family.
Library
May I, master?
Me
Yeah, I'm ready.
We were in a huge practice room of the underground training complex beneath the schoolyard of Gosha Academy.
It was a training facility we often used in class where you could engage in various combat simulations that combined 3D projections and robot technology.
I was there that day to receive Taima Kill drills from Library.
As Danjo's former confidant and a former UFS cyborg soldier, and now as Gosha's latest cyborg Taimanin, his guidance was precise.
Up until now, I'd been barely scraping by with my knowledge from books, unidentified demonic powers, and a little bit of battle experience,
but for the first time in a long time, I was experiencing a sense of fulfillment and growth from being retrained from the basics by Library.
Library
Then I'll now begin the battle simulation.
The location changed to some downtown area, and a drone appeared before me.
It was an one-eyed humanoid drone holding an electromagnetic baton in its right hand.
Its overall figure was lanky, and the drive joints at its elbows and knees were bare, but because it was light, its movements were fluid.
Library
This is your training partner today.
Library
The BR-2 Kanemitsu. It's a domestic humanoid drone weapon. Commonly known as a battle droid. Have you heard of it?
Me
These guys move as quickly as real soldiers because of Devildomian medical technology and AI chips. Well, he has an electromagnetic baton, so he must be designed to be a security guard.
Library
That's right. Its battle software is a special version from Gosha Village. It's the most suitable opponent for your training, master.
Me
I'm asking just in case, but is this guy a 3D projection too?
Library
No, it's the real thing.
Me
How about that stick's power? Is it set to stun? Or kill?
Library
It's set to stun, but the voltage level is at the maximum. It would kill a normal person instantly. Even a Taimanin will pass out.
Me
That's scary.
Library
If you underestimate it and let your guard down, you might get seriously injured. Please be careful.
Me
Understood.
